task: Create one square profile avatar portrait for a board-game UI, as a finished illustration (not a photo).

style.medium: Hand-drawn cartoon illustration by a professional comic and children's-book illustrator; confident dark-brown ink linework, expressive sketch hatching, soft watercolor washes, and simple colored-pencil shading.
style.character_design: Humorous, charming, slightly exaggerated caricature with large expressive eyes and a mischievous grin; warm and friendly, never crude.
style.palette: Warm natural earth tones, muted pastels, cream, warm gray, taupe, and golden yellow; gentle highlights; no neon colors.
style.background: Plain warm cream paper background with subtle grain and a soft round light-cream halo behind the head. No scenery.
style.linework: Loose but confident dark-brown/near-black ink outlines, varied hand-drawn strokes, fine hatching and crosshatching for fur and shadows.
style.shading: Soft watercolor texture with colored-pencil accents and small cream highlights; avoid glossy, photorealistic, or 3D rendering.
style.consistency: Same hand, line weight, watercolor shading and humor as the bald baffled man on the 0-money card of this set; all five portraits must look like one family of characters.

portrait.subject: Berta, a plump elderly farm woman in her seventies with rosy apple cheeks
portrait.features: Grey hair in a tight bun with a pencil stuck through it, small round glasses slid down to the tip of her nose, a flowered headscarf knotted under her chin.
portrait.facial_expression: Suspicious, knowing smirk: one eyebrow raised extremely high, the other squinting, lips pursed to one side as if she just saw through a bluff.
portrait.outfit: Wearing a blue checkered apron over a knitted cardigan; a tiny feather caught in her hair.
portrait.pose: Head and shoulders, facing the viewer (slight three-quarter turn allowed), head centered.
portrait.text_rule: No text, letters, numbers, logos or name tags anywhere.

composition.framing: Head fills about 60% of the image height, centered with even margin on all sides so the image can be cropped into a circle without cutting off the hair, hat or ears.
